notes.title: Patch Notes 002
notes.content: [p][b]Changes [/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Health Bar & Oxygen text next to the bars [/p][/*][*][p]Added new Health Bar & Oxygen assets [/p][/*][*][p]Added outline for interaction text [/p][/*][*][p]Added credit names [/p][/*][*][p]Added an intro screen for the end game goal [/p][/*][*][p]Added intro end game text [/p][/*][*][p]Added door and station signs [/p][/*][*][p]Added sound effects for low health and oxygen [/p][/*][*][p]Added new charging station model [/p][/*][*][p]Added new UI changes to inventory, & hotbar[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted elevator level panel [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted intro goal screen time [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the starting crate inventories again because they reset to default testing [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the oxygen and health bar placements[/p][/*][*][p]Made minor changes to the space station[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed getting stuck in the rocket hole [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the hallway sparks volume settings [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tooltip going off screen when hovering over an item in he inventory [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed known bug: issue where the Space Station gate is open when the player closes the elevator door from the crater bed [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Bugs[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Flashing tooltip when hovering over an item in the inventory with the mouse (Not on controller) [/p][/*][*][p]Frame loss when looking around the lights [/p][/*][*][p]Elevator speed going down into the crater sometimes causes the player to pop out of the roof when moving or looking around.[/p][/*][/list]
